profile.legalName: Connected The National Center For College And Career
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Berkeley, California, that partners with schools, districts and communities to put Linked Learning into practice. Linked Learning is an approach that connects classroom learning to real-world college and career experiences. The organization offers coaching, curriculum design, professional development and other resources.
